# Instructions for data analysis done entirely from scratch using the "g" language to fill the gaps in the falsified research report

1. Generate fake data of the required size.
2. Set the factors for the research report.
3. Analyse the fake data using the two-way ANOVA, iApply22 and t-test methods.
4. Generate plots with an appropriate scale.
5. Replace the "g" code in the gcode.txt file with the "g" code generated in Step 3.
6. Run "r run.r" to generate the final results.
7. Replace the tables in the final report, except for "Table 6" and "Table 7".
8. Calculate the significance and adjusted p-values for multiple comparisons.
